name: absent_cursor_hold_across_reset
comment: review F5-02 (PH0-D19): a held read whose ORIGINAL request had an absent cursor holds (no snapshot yet, no timeout_ms); a producer SwmrReset must NOT force-answer it `state=reset` (there is nothing to have been reset FROM) -- this step emits NOTHING for s1, which stays held; a later snapshot_push then releases it normally with the fresh data ("resolves with a fresh snapshot of the new state")
